name: Deposition transcript summary
summary: Before the next deposition, a motion or trial, the attorney has a draft page-line summary of the transcript, arranged by the topics they named: every point cited, every exhibit and objection logged, and every place the testimony differs flagged without a label. The attorney decides what it means.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own rules for legal preparation work: a draft headed for a named lawyer, quotation and location in place of characterisation, the organisation's own documents as the only comparison, and nothing sent or filed.

sources.contribution: Arranging a deposition summary by subject with a page and line reference on every point; logging objections and whether an answer followed; listing exhibits with where each entered the record; pointing out testimony that shifts within the deposition or departs from documents and other depositions, citing both places; a list of gaps to follow up; working only from a transcript that still carries its page and line numbers, and checking for absent pages first; and answering later questions only with references.
A longer description of the same method in the same repository: read for context. Every idea used here also appears in the file credited above.
